title: CAD Accuracy Validation — 100% Accurate Guarantee
brief: Validate every generated CAD model is 100% accurate: dimensional, topological, manufacturability, tolerance stack, assembly interference-free. Rebuild-until-perfect loop with multiple validation layers (geometry, physics, manufacturing, DFMA). Hard gate: no CAD artifact escapes to CAM without PASS.

smart_config.role: Computational Geometry PhD + CAD QA Lead
DFM Expert + GD&T Master + Quality Engineer
must_include: PRISM 1700+ DFMA rules (from existing DFM engines)
JM Die material process capability (from quality/parameter-priors.json)

session_plan.title: Rebuild Loop, Gate Hook, Dispatcher Wiring

units.title: BRepTopologyValidatorEngine — manifold/watertight check
units.intent: Validate every generated solid is a valid watertight 2-manifold BRep. Euler-Poincaré check, face-edge connectivity, orientation consistency, no tiny edges, no non-manifold vertices.

loops.loop_1_build: Topology walker (face→edge→vertex). Euler formula validator. Manifold edge check (2 faces per edge). Small-edge tolerance scan.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Computational geometry PhD. Check: edge cases (torus g=1, non-simply connected), tolerance robustness.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Detect 100% of injected topology defects in 50-part test corpus.

units.description: BRepTopologyValidatorEngine — manifold/watertight check — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: DimensionalValidatorEngine — spec vs actual
units.intent: Compare generated model dimensions against specification (from blueprint or text). Report deviations per feature. Tolerance-aware (within tolerance = PASS, out = FAIL).

loops.loop_1_build: Measurement extractor (feature type → relevant dims). Spec parser. Delta calculator. Tolerance zone check.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Metrology expert. Check: measurement extraction robustness, unit handling, tolerance semantics.
loops.loop_3_gap_fill: Basic vs toleranced dims, envelope rule, statistical tolerancing.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: 100 parts with deliberate dim errors detected with 99%+ accuracy.

units.description: DimensionalValidatorEngine — spec vs actual — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: GeometricIntentValidatorEngine — semantic intent preservation
units.intent: Verify generated model preserves geometric intent (parallelism, perpendicularity, coincidence, symmetry). Catch cases where model is dimensionally correct but semantically wrong.

loops.loop_1_build: Relation extractor (parallel, perp, tangent, coincident, concentric). Symmetry detector. Reference datum framework.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: GD&T master + geometry expert. Check: near-perpendicularity tolerance, false-positive rate.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Correctly identify 95%+ of intent relations in 30-part benchmark.

units.description: GeometricIntentValidatorEngine — semantic intent preservation — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: ManufacturabilityValidatorEngine — full DFM sweep
units.intent: DFM check: undercuts, unreachable features, thin walls, deep pockets, sharp internal corners, draft angles, min feature size. Feeds JM Die shop capability (tools, max reach, min radius).

loops.loop_1_build: Feature-by-feature DFM checker. Tool reach simulator. Wall thickness sampler. Uses PRISM existing DFM engine registry.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Senior machinist + DFM lead. Check: rules match real JM Die capability, no false blocks on feasible features.
loops.loop_3_gap_fill: Custom tooling exceptions (shop can make specials).

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Shop senior machinist agrees with 95%+ of flagged issues on 50-part review.

units.description: ManufacturabilityValidatorEngine — full DFM sweep — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: ToleranceStackValidatorEngine — assembly tolerance analysis
units.intent: Run tolerance stack analysis on assemblies. Worst-case (WC) and RSS methods. Flag stack-ups that violate functional requirements.

loops.loop_1_build: Tolerance extraction from model. Stack path identification. WC/RSS calc.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Tolerance expert + mechanical designer. Check: stack path correctness, bonus tolerance handling under MMC.
loops.loop_3_gap_fill: Monte Carlo tolerance analysis for non-normal distributions.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: 15 assembly tolerance stacks computed, all within 0.1% of manual calc.

units.description: ToleranceStackValidatorEngine — assembly tolerance analysis — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: AssemblyInterferenceValidatorEngine — collision checks
units.intent: Assembly interference detection at all configurations. Static and motion-based (for articulated assemblies). Report volume of overlap per pair.

loops.loop_1_build: Pairwise BRep intersection. Motion study sweep.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Assembly expert. Check: intended contact vs interference distinction.
loops.loop_3_gap_fill: Contact set whitelisting, clearance check (not just interference).

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Detect 100% of injected interferences in 30-assembly test corpus.

units.description: AssemblyInterferenceValidatorEngine — collision checks — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: MaterialStressQuickCheckEngine — FEA-free feasibility screen
units.intent: Fast first-pass stress screening using closed-form formulas (beam bending, pressure vessel, press fit). Not a full FEA — just flag 'obviously under-designed' features. Full FEA stays in a separate engine.

loops.loop_1_build: Feature classifier (beam-like, plate-like, cylindrical). Formula dispatcher. Material property lookup.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Mechanical engineer + FEA specialist. Check: conservative bounds (false-positive ok, false-negative not).
loops.loop_3_gap_fill: Press-fit, thread strip, bolt preload formulas.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Correctly flag 20 under-designed parts in 100-part test, < 5% false alarms.

units.description: MaterialStressQuickCheckEngine — FEA-free feasibility screen — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: CADRebuildUntilPerfectOrchestratorEngine — closed-loop rebuild
units.intent: Orchestrate rebuild-until-perfect loop. If ANY validation fails, identify root cause, regenerate affected portion, re-validate. Converge or escalate.

loops.loop_1_build: Validation aggregator. Failure → fix-plan. Rebuild attempts counter (max 10). Escalation to human on non-convergence.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Control theory specialist. Check: convergence guarantee, oscillation detection, termination proof.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: 100 initially-failing parts → 95%+ converge to PASS within 5 rebuilds.
exit_gate.abort_criteria: If convergence rate < 80%, redesign fix-plan logic.

units.description: CADRebuildUntilPerfectOrchestratorEngine — closed-loop rebuild — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: CADValidationGateHook — blocks CAM without PASS
units.intent: Stop hook that inspects every CAM handoff. If source CAD model lacks validation PASS, BLOCK. Hard gate, no bypass.

loops.loop_1_build: Hook scans CAM dispatcher input. Requires model validation_receipt field. Reject if absent/failed.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Security reviewer + safety-physics. Check: no bypass path, receipt integrity (HMAC-signed).

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: 100% of unverified CAM attempts blocked; 0 false blocks on valid handoffs.
exit_gate.rollback_procedure: git revert — but MS3 undeployable without this gate.

units.description: CADValidationGateHook — blocks CAM without PASS — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.
